EVIDENCE RULES: Use only E-IDs and exact URLs from the 37-row evidence ledger. You may read or refetch those public URLs to verify interpretation, but do not add sources. Public data does not establish true patient volume, payer mix, review volume, drive-time choice counts, capacity, conversion, profitability, leakage, or owner dependence. Scores must therefore be conservative, explainable, and capped at confidence C or D. If peer percentile evidence is incomplete, use the rubric's qualitative-band allowance and state the limitation. Never create dollar forecasts or imply measured demand.

SCORING CONTRACT: scores_recommendation.json must follow OUTPUT_SCHEMA v2 as closely as public evidence permits. Include at least these top-level keys: schema_version, analysis_product, data_mode, report_visibility, practice, market, scores, subscores, competitor_tiers, specialty_options, drivers, white_space, recommended_actions, data_quality, disconfirmers, hidden_appendices. Under scores include market_demand_supply_score, competitive_pressure_index, room_to_win_score, practice_competitiveness_score, client_opportunity_score, confidence_grade. Room to Win must equal 100 minus Competitive Pressure Index. All client-facing scores must read high=better or carry direction metadata. Tier 1 and Tier 2 only; Tier 3 hidden. Use no more than three recommended actions. Every driver and score rationale must cite one or more ledger E-IDs, carry confidence, and separate verified fact from inference.

RESEARCH OUTPUT CONTRACT: research.md must start '# Vintage Optical One-Pager Research' and include exactly these named sections: ## The Read, ## Verified Inputs, ## Score Rationale, ## Competitor Tiers, ## Opportunity Lanes, ## Three Actions, ## Disconfirmers, ## Missing Data, ## Decision Residue. The Read must reconcile the score stack in plain English. The actions must be small tests, not accusations. State the hardest decision, alternatives rejected, and least-confident assumption. Keep 600-2600 words.

HOW TO VERIFY before stopping: run python3 /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/vintage-optical-onepager/checks/validate_research.py --report research.md --scores scores_recommendation.json --ledger /mnt/d_drive/repos/vintage-optical-competitive-analysis/RESEARCH/Paul_Velting_Vintage_Optical/04_evidence_ledger.csv and fix every WHY failure inside your two owned files. Hard rule: a validator pass is necessary but not permission to overstate evidence.
